candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout ~2s); order in turn times out calling payment /v1/authorizations (~2s), while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly. The latency originates in the payment dependency path.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side telemetry; cannot confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable. Redis/inventory healthy.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 driven by order ReadTimeout, which is driven by payment ReadTimeout; inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics show checkout p95 ~2387ms and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment. Payment-side evidence is absent, so the bounded candidate is downstream latency on the payment path.
